name: DLP controls MUST be implemented on email, collaboration tools, and corporate endpoints to prevent the unauthorized transmission of high-risk sensitive data.
conditionsText: Email, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, or corporate devices.
requirementTitle: DLP controls MUST be implemented on email, collaboration tools, and corporate endpoints to prevent the unauthorized transmission of high-risk sensitive data.
requirementDescription: The organisation must have controls (DLP - Data Loss Prevention) in place to detect and stop people from accidentally or deliberately sending sensitive information outside the organisation through email, Teams/SharePoint, or company devices.
why:
Most data breaches don't involve sophisticated hackers.
Many occur because of accidental disclosure, unauthorised sharing, and insider activity
